aliases: Google MidAmerica Industrial Park data center
status_detail: Google's official data center location page says the Mayes County, Oklahoma data center was announced/built in 2007, expanded in 2012, 2015 and 2019, and is part of Google's 2025 Oklahoma cloud and AI infrastructure investment.
notes: Official Google page provides the strongest evidence and contact email mayescounty@google.com. Oklahoma Commerce's 2017 release says the campus is at MidAmerica Industrial Park near Pryor and described a $600M expansion; third-party maps identify 4581 Webb St / 3500-4175 Main St, Pryor.
